Ran full public inscricao flow in browser (pmsc.html modal -> Inscreva-se -> termos?c=pmpe -> inscricao -> dados-inscricao VAGA=201 + SC city -> confirmacao -> inscricao-realizada -> PAGAR INSCRICAO -> pagamento-pix). QR rendered. The new 'IMPRIMIR COMPROVANTE' button [data-testid=btn-imprimir-comprovante] appears to the RIGHT of 'VOLTAR' (x=659 > x=502). Clicking it opens a NEW TAB with a well-designed comprovante showing: title 'COMPROVANTE DE INSCRICAO', 'PMSC 2026', 'Policia Militar de Santa Catarina', protocolo (2026194400), nome, formatted CPF (932.561.944-00), cargo 'Soldado do Quadro de Pracas Policial Militar (QPPM)', 'R$ 200,00', a Data da inscricao value, pmsc logo img (naturalWidth=366), Pix QR img (naturalWidth=392), and 'Imprimir'+'Fechar' buttons. NO copia-e-cola code present. Backend recorded PIX baixado (inscricoes.pix_status='PIX baixado'; compute_status surfaces it for admin list + KPI; pix_downloaded doc upserted). Rename verified: homepage 'Acessar' -> /pmsc.html (200) loads PMSC page+modal; Inscreva-se -> termos.html?c=pmpe; pmpe.html file removed, no pmpe.html links in public/. pytest test_pmsc_rebrand.py 13/13 PASS (after I updated the obsolete test_pmpe_modal_date to fetch /pmsc.html).

integration_issues.issue: pagamento-pix.html line ~1058 fetches '/api/inscricao-resumo?cpf=<cpf>&cargo=<codigo>' (hyphenated, query-param) which does NOT exist and returns HTTP 404. The real backend route is '/api/inscricao/resumo/{cpf}?cargo=...' (path param). Because the fetch 404s, the comprovante falls back to hojeBR() (the client's TODAY date) for 'Data da inscricao'. It only coincidentally displayed 16/11/2026 during this test because the server/browser clock is 16/11/2026; the ACTUAL inscription date returned by the backend is 15/11/2026. On any day != the inscription date the comprovante shows the wrong 'Data da inscricao'. Fix: change the frontend fetch URL to '/api/inscricao/resumo/' + encodeURIComponent(cpfDigits) + (vagaInfo.codigo ? '?cargo=' + encodeURIComponent(vagaInfo.codigo) : '').

rca of the issue: Frontend/backend route mismatch. pagamento-pix.html calls window.location.origin + '/api/inscricao-resumo?cpf=' + cpf + '&cargo=' + codigo. FastAPI only registers '@admin_router.get(/inscricao/resumo/{cpf})' (prefix /api). The hyphen/query-param variant is unregistered => 404 => r.ok false => render('') => comprovante uses hojeBR() (today). Reproduced: curl /api/inscricao-resumo?cpf=...->{'detail':'Not Found'}; curl /api/inscricao/resumo/<cpf>?cargo=201->200 with data_inscricao=15/11/2026 while comprovante displayed 16/11/2026 (today).
